_about: One file for the admin Help guide: the words Shaun reads AND the steps the robot taps to take the pictures, so they can't drift apart. `npm run guide` replays every task on local wrangler dev (seed content, phone size 390x844), takes one picture per step with the control to tap highlighted, records a short silent clip per task, and writes public/admin/help/. In captions, {Words} become pink button labels. In fill text, {+7d} becomes the date 7 days from today.

tasks.title: Put admin on your home screen
tasks.tip: Had a CMS Admin icon from before? Press and hold it, tap {Remove}, then add it again with these steps.

steps.caption: On your phone, open cmscookieco3more.com/kitchen in Safari (iPhone) or Chrome (Android).
iPhone: tap the Share button (square with an arrow), then {Add to Home Screen}. If you see {Open as Web App}, switch it off. Tap {Add}.
Android: tap the three dots ⋮ in the corner, then {Add to Home screen}. Chrome asks {Install} or {Create shortcut}: tap {Create shortcut}, then {Add}.
Tap the new {CMS Admin} cookie icon any time. Your kitchen opens.
About once a month it asks for your email and a code. That's normal. Then you're back in.

tasks.title: Fix a photo (frame it, brighten, add words)
tasks.tip: Changed your mind? {Undo}, {Start over} and {Cancel} are always there. Nothing is saved until you tap {Save} on the form.

steps.caption: Anywhere you add a photo, tap {Choose photo}. Or tap {Take photo} to use the camera.
Drag the photo with one finger to move it. Pinch, or slide {Zoom}, to make it bigger.
Photo too dark? Slide {Brighten} to the right.
Tap {Add words}, type them, and pick a style: pink ribbon, script or bold.
Tap {Add to photo}. Drag the words where you like, pinch to resize, then tap {Done}.
Happy with it? Tap {Use this photo}.

tasks.title: Set the Cookie of the Month
tasks.tip: Only the newest Cookie of the Month shows. Pick an {Ends} date and it comes down by itself.

steps.caption: Tap {Specials} at the bottom of the screen.
Tap {+ New special}. (To change last month's, tap {Edit} on it instead.)
Change {Type} to {Cookie of the Month}. Type the {Title}, {Description} and {Price}.

before.text: Soft gingerbread rolled in sugar. December only!

steps.caption: Tap {Choose photo}. Frame your cookie in the circle, then tap {Use this photo}.
Tap {Save}. It shows at the top of the home page right away.

tasks.title: Post a special
tasks.tip: Need to take it down early? Tap {Edit} and switch off {Show on the site}.

steps.caption: Tap {Specials}, then {+ New special}.
Leave {Type} as {Special}. Type a {Title}, a short {Description} and the {Price}. No price? People can text you instead.

before.text: 3 cookies, 3 colors of frosting and sprinkles.

steps.caption: Tap {Choose photo}. Specials show as a wide picture, so frame it in the wide box.
Pick an {Ends} date so it disappears on its own.
Tap {Save}.

tasks.title: Add an event
tasks.tip: A PDF flyer? Take a screenshot of it and use the screenshot.

steps.caption: Tap {Events}, then {+ New event}.
Type the {Title}, pick the {Date}, and add {Details} like the time and place.

before.text: Find Shaun's table by the tree, 10am to 3pm.

steps.caption: Under {Flyer}, tap {Choose photo}. The whole flyer is used, nothing gets cut off. Tap {Use this photo}.
People sign up somewhere else? Paste that link in {RSVP link}. (To take signups right here, see “Take signups for an event”.)
Tap {Save}. The event leaves the site by itself after the date.

tasks.title: Take signups for an event
tasks.tip: A Draft never shows on the home page, so you can check everything first. Each signup also arrives in your email. Tap {Signups} on the event to see who's coming, text them, and switch on {Paid} and {Checked in}.

steps.caption: Tap {Events}, then {+ New event}.
Set {On the site?} to {Draft: only you can see it}. Type the title, date and details, and add the flyer.

before.text: Decorate 6 cookies to take home. 1 to 2:30pm.

steps.caption: Switch on {Take signups on the site}. Type the {Price per spot} and {How many spots}.
Tap {Save}. It's saved as a Draft.
Tap {Preview} to try the signup form the way customers see it. Then remove your test signup under {Signups}.
All good? Tap {Edit}, change {On the site?} to {Published}, and tap {Save}. Now customers can sign up.

tasks.title: Add a new flavor
tasks.tip: Only around for a season? Fill in {Starts} and {Ends} and it shows up and comes down by itself.

steps.caption: Tap {Menu} at the bottom of the screen.
Tap {+ Add a flavor}.
Type the {Flavor name}, a {Short name} for the box buttons, and a {Description}.

before.text: Chocolate cookie with crushed candy canes.

steps.caption: Tap {Choose photo}, frame the cookie in the circle, and tap {Use this photo}.
Leave {Part of the Cookie Tasting Flight} on if it goes in the flight. Tap {Save}.
It's in the box builder now. Use {↑} and {↓} to move it in the list.

tasks.title: Add a new treat
tasks.tip: Treats show in a {More Treats} box on the home page, with an {Add} button so people can order them.

steps.caption: Tap {Menu}, then {+ Add a treat}.
Type the {Treat name} and {Price}. {Group} is optional, like “Kits” or “Gift boxes”.
Tap {Choose photo}. Want a price tag on it? Tap {Add sticker}, then {Price tag}.
Tap {Use this photo}.
Tap {Save}. Switch it off any time to hide it.

tasks.title: Add something with a price (treat or special, with sizes)
tasks.tip: A {treat} stays on your menu until you switch it off. A {special} is for a limited time: give it an {Ends} date and it comes down by itself. Both can have sizes.

steps.caption: Tap {Menu} at the bottom of the screen.
Always on your menu? Tap {+ Add a treat}. Just for a little while? Tap {+ Add a special} instead.
Type the {Treat name}. Pick a {Group}, like Kits, or type your own.
One price? Type it in {Price}. Comes in sizes? Tap {+ Add a size} and type each size and its price.
Add a photo with {Choose photo}, then tap {Save}. On the site, people pick a size and the price follows.

tasks.title: Change a price or turn something off
tasks.tip: Switched off things disappear from the site, and nobody can order them, until you switch them back on.

steps.caption: Tap {Menu} at the bottom of the screen.
Tap a price and type the new one. Tap anywhere else and it saves by itself.
Out of something? Tap its switch to turn it off. Tap again to turn it back on.
Grey means hidden from the site. Green means people can order it.

tasks.title: Confirm an order and mark it paid
tasks.tip: New orders also arrive in your email. {Open} shows orders that still need confirming or paying; {All} shows everything.

steps.caption: Tap {Orders}. New orders are at the top with a pink {New} tag.
Tap {Text} to message the customer and agree on the details.
All set? Switch on {Confirmed}.
When they've paid, switch on {Paid}. Done orders drop off the {Open} list.
Tap {All} to see older orders again.

tasks.title: How customers pay you
tasks.tip: Nobody pays through the website. Venmo and Cash App money goes straight into your Venmo or Cash App, and cash is paid when they pick up.

steps.caption: Tap {Payments} at the bottom of the screen.
Customers only see the ways that are switched on. After they order, they get a button that opens Venmo with the amount and order number filled in.
To change your Venmo name, tap the box and type the new one. Tap anywhere else and it saves by itself.
Want Cash App too? Type your $cashtag, then switch Cash App on.
Money came in? Tap {Orders}. The Venmo note has the order number in it.
Find that order and switch on {Paid}.

tasks.title: Connect Square (card payments)
tasks.tip: You only do this once. If Square ever stops working, Payments tells you and shows {Connect Square} again. {Disconnect} turns card payments off completely.

steps.caption: Tap {Payments} at the bottom of the screen.
On {Card (Square)}, tap {Connect Square}.
Square opens. Sign in with your Square email and password if it asks, then tap {Allow}.
You're back here. It says {Connected as} and your business name.
Ready? Switch Card on. Customers then see {Pay with card} after they order or sign up.
Square takes a fee on each card payment. See your Square app for the amount. Refunds and payouts: tap {Open Square}.

tasks.title: When a customer pays by card
tasks.tip: Orders, event signups and catering quotes paid by card all switch to {Paid by card} by themselves. The spreadsheets have a Payment method column.

steps.caption: After a customer orders, they see {Pay with card} (when Card is switched on).
Square's own page opens. They type their card there, never on your website.
Paid! They come back to a thank-you note with their order number.
In {Orders} it already says {Paid by card}. You don't need to switch anything.
Need to give money back? Tap {Refund? Open Square} and refund it in Square.

tasks.title: Send a pay link
tasks.tip: The link is for exactly what they owe: the order total, the signup, or the quote you typed for a catering request. Square emails them a receipt.

steps.caption: In {Orders}, on an order that isn't paid yet, tap {💳 Send pay link}.
A card payment link appears, for exactly what they owe.
Tap {Text it to …}. Your messages app opens with the link typed in. Hit send.
Or tap {Copy link} and paste it in any message.
Signups and catering requests have the same button, once you've typed a quote.

tasks.title: Turn on Catering and add a package
tasks.tip: In the same place you can change the words at the top, how many days' notice you need, and the list of things you cater. Tap {Save} under them.

steps.caption: Tap {Requests} at the bottom of the screen.
Tap {Catering settings}.
Switch on {Show Catering on the website}. A Catering button and box appear on the home page.
Want a package people can ask about? Tap {+ Add a package}.
Type the name, what's in it, the {From} price and how many it {Serves}. Add a photo, then tap {Save}.

before.text: Four dozen cookies, mixed flavors, with a bow.

tasks.title: Answer a catering request (text them, set a quote, mark Booked)
tasks.tip: New requests also come to your email. {Open} shows the ones still going; {All} shows everything, and you can download a spreadsheet at the bottom.

steps.caption: Tap {Requests}. New ones have a pink {New} tag.
Tap {Text} to message them about their event.
When you know the price, type it in {Your quote}. It saves by itself.
Sent them the quote? Tap {Quoted}.
They said yes? Tap {Booked}. Jot anything to remember in {Your notes}. Only you see them.

after.text: Deliver by 11. Pink and gold boxes.

tasks.title: Download a spreadsheet
tasks.tip: The file opens in Excel, Numbers or Google Sheets. It has names and phone numbers, so keep it to yourself.

steps.caption: Orders: on {Orders}, scroll down and tap {Download a spreadsheet of orders}.
Pick the dates. It starts as the last 30 days.
Tap {Download spreadsheet}.
Event signups: tap {Events}.
Tap {Signups} on the event.
Tap {Download spreadsheet}. It lists everyone, their spots, and who has paid and checked in.

tasks.title: Share a tip video
tasks.tip: Video from your phone? Tap {Video} instead and choose it. First time only on iPhone: Settings → Camera → Formats → Most Compatible. If a video won't upload, post it as an Instagram reel and paste the link.

steps.caption: Tap {Media} at the bottom of the screen.
Easiest: in Instagram, open your reel, tap Share, then Copy link. Here, tap {Instagram link}.
Paste the link and write a {Caption}.

after.text: Tip of the Week: chill your dough for thicker cookies.

steps.caption: Leave {Feature on the home page} on. The newest one becomes the Tip of the Week.
Tap {Add}.
